name: Dome-DETR
paper_title: Dome-DETR: DETR with Density-Oriented Feature-Query Manipulation for Efficient Tiny Object Detection
license_interpretation: The code and the weights part company here. The upstream repository is Apache-2.0, permissive and safe for commercial and closed-source use, and LibreYOLO's own port is MIT, so nothing restricts the architecture or the training code. The weights are the unresolved part: the upstream model card carries no license field in its metadata, and its prose states that the project is Apache-2.0 while also restricting the material to academic research purposes only. Those two readings do not agree, and the stricter one is not a grant to redistribute, so LibreYOLO mirrors nothing for this family and hosts no checkpoint. Download the six upstream checkpoints yourself and convert them with weights/convert_domedetr_weights.py, and read the upstream terms before using them for anything commercial. Weights you train yourself on your own data derive from no upstream checkpoint and are yours.
bibtex_verified: No BibTeX block is published by the authors. The upstream repository README at github.com/RicePasteM/Dome-DETR carries no citation section, and no @inproceedings or @article entry for Dome-DETR exists anywhere in the LibreYOLO source tree. The paper is 'Dome-DETR: DETR with Density-Oriented Feature-Query Manipulation for Efficient Tiny Object Detection', ACM Multimedia 2025, arXiv 2505.05741. bibtex is left null rather than assembled by hand; do not invent one. If the authors publish an entry, copy it verbatim and record the check here.
